## Purpose and interpretation

This report contains the analyses from `01_exploratory_analysis.R` and adds
checks needed before estimating lateral response onset. Repeated versions of
the same plot are consolidated. The original R script is unchanged; this report
is self-contained and reads the trial CSV files directly.

The project README specifies 1,000 Hz sampling, acceleration obtained by
differentiating lateral hand position twice, and a response-search window from
the **Pixel event to Got target or Missed target**. An extended plotting window
provides context but does not extend the response-search window. Both hit and
miss trials are retained when their events and signals are valid.

::: {.callout-important}
The filename-to-response mapping still needs confirmation from the data owner.
The proposed mapping is LeftBackground = left, RightBackground = right, and
StaticBackground = none. The proposed coordinate signs are left = -1 and
right = +1. EDA runs without confirming these assumptions. The onset-method
section runs only when `mapping_confirmed: true` is set after confirming both
the labels and signs. Inspect Conditions A/B separately; their meaning is not
inferred here.
:::

The default uses **unsmoothed, position-derived acceleration**. The smoothing
sensitivity section compares alternative centered windows without selecting a
preferred window from the results. Change `smoothing_ms` only with a documented
reason: smoothing can change peak shape, threshold crossings, and onset.

## Setup and reusable functions

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, dpi = 130)

data_dir <- params$data_dir
if (!dir.exists(data_dir) && dir.exists(file.path("capstone-project", data_dir))) {
  data_dir <- file.path("capstone-project", data_dir)
}
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) stop("Data folder not found. Set params$data_dir.")
output_dir <- file.path("eda_output")
if (isTRUE(params$export_results)) dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

fs <- 1000
baseline_limits <- c(-200, -20)
plot_limits <- c(-200, 500)
gmr_threshold <- 0.20
alignment_threshold <- 0.125
fit_half_width <- 20
smooth_n <- as.integer(params$smoothing_ms)
if (length(smooth_n) != 1 || is.na(smooth_n) || smooth_n < 1 || smooth_n %% 2 != 1) {
  stop("smoothing_ms must be a positive odd integer (1 means no smoothing).")
}
if (any(!c(params$left_response_sign, params$right_response_sign) %in% c(-1, 1))) {
  stop("Response signs must be -1 or +1.")
}

event_columns <- c("Command to move FF", "Got target", "Hand in start",
  "Hand left start (good)", "Hand out start (bad)", "Missed target",
  "Pixel event", "Show hand feedback", "Target starts moving")
signal_columns <- c("Frame", "Right_HandX", "Right_HandY", "Right_HandVelX",
                    "Right_HandVelY", "Right_HandAccX", "Right_HandAccY")

finite_mean <- function(x) if (any(is.finite(x))) mean(x[is.finite(x)]) else NA_real_
finite_sd <- function(x) if (sum(is.finite(x)) > 1) sd(x[is.finite(x)]) else NA_real_
finite_max <- function(x) if (any(is.finite(x))) max(x[is.finite(x)]) else NA_real_
finite_min <- function(x) if (any(is.finite(x))) min(x[is.finite(x)]) else NA_real_
safe_cor <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) < 3 || sd(x[ok]) == 0 || sd(y[ok]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cor(x[ok], y[ok])
}
center_mean <- function(x, n = 1L) {
  if (n == 1L) return(x)
  if (length(x) < n) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1 / n, n), sides = 2))
}
differentiate <- function(x, time_s) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 3) return(rep(NA_real_, n))
  span <- time_s[3:n] - time_s[1:(n - 2)]
  result <- (x[3:n] - x[1:(n - 2)]) / span
  result[!is.finite(span) | span <= 0] <- NA_real_
  c(NA_real_, result, NA_real_)
}
event_values <- function(x) {
  text <- trimws(as.character(x))
  text <- text[!is.na(text) & nzchar(text)]
  # Do not silently use the first value if an event is repeated or malformed.
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(text))
}
one_event <- function(x) {
  z <- event_values(x)
  if (length(z) == 1 && is.finite(z)) z else NA_real_
}
show_table <- function(x, digits = 2) knitr::kable(x, digits = digits)
save_table <- function(x, name) {
  if (isTRUE(params$export_results)) readr::write_csv(x, file.path(output_dir, name))
}
save_figure <- function(x, name, width = 10, height = 6) {
  if (isTRUE(params$export_results)) {
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, name), x, width = width, height = height, dpi = 200)
  }
}
event_lines <- function() geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray35")
background_colors <- c(LeftBackground = "#0072B2", RightBackground = "#D55E00",
                       StaticBackground = "#009E73")
```

## File inventory and trial metadata

This replaces original Sections 1–3, 8–9, and 13. Trial IDs use the full path,
because trial numbers repeat across participants, conditions, and blocks.

```{r}
#| label: trial-inventory
trial_files <- sort(list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE,
                              full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE))
if (!length(trial_files)) stop("No trial CSV files found.")
trial_info <- tibble(File = trial_files) |>
  mutate(
    Trial_ID = File,
    Participant = str_extract(File, "Participant [AB]"),
    Block_Folder = basename(dirname(File)),
    Condition = str_extract(Block_Folder, "(?<=Condition_)[AB]"),
    Block = as.integer(str_extract(Block_Folder, "(?<=Block_)\\d+")),
    Trial = as.integer(str_extract(basename(File), "(?<=Trial)\\d+")),
    Background = str_extract(basename(File), "LeftBackground|RightBackground|StaticBackground"),
    Target_Speed = str_extract(basename(File), "FastTarget|SlowTarget")
  )
if (anyNA(trial_info[c("Participant", "Condition", "Block", "Trial", "Background", "Target_Speed")])) {
  stop("Some filenames could not be mapped to metadata; inspect trial_info.")
}
show_table(trial_info |> select(-Trial_ID) |> head(10))
show_table(trial_info |> count(Participant, Condition, Block, name = "Trials"))
show_table(trial_info |> count(Background, Target_Speed, name = "Trials"))
show_table(trial_info |> count(Participant, Condition, Block, Trial) |> filter(n > 1))

cell_counts <- trial_info |> count(Participant, Condition, Block, Background, Target_Speed) |>
  complete(Participant, Condition, Block, Background, Target_Speed, fill = list(n = 0))
ggplot(cell_counts, aes(factor(Block), Background, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = n, color = n < 18)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(Participant + Condition ~ Target_Speed) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() + labs(x = "Block", y = NULL, fill = "Trials",
    title = "Trial coverage across the complete experimental design")
save_table(trial_info, "trial_metadata.csv")
```

## Import, event validation, and position-derived signals

Each file is read once for the main analysis. Checks use the full recording
before cropping. A trial must have one numeric Pixel event, exactly one numeric
hit or miss event, consecutive integer frames at 1 ms intervals, and complete
position-derived acceleration throughout its response window to enter the
expanded response analyses. Failed imports and invalid trials stay in the audit.

Centered differences use actual frame times in **seconds**. They leave missing
values at derivative boundaries rather than extrapolating. Optional centered
smoothing is applied to position before differentiation. The full recording is
processed before the plotting window is selected.

```{r}
#| label: import-functions
read_trial <- function(file) {
  raw <- read_csv(file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                  show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
  missing_columns <- setdiff(c(signal_columns, event_columns), names(raw))
  if (length(missing_columns)) stop(paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")))
  d <- raw |> mutate(across(all_of(signal_columns), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))
  pixel <- one_event(raw$`Pixel event`)
  hit <- event_values(raw$`Got target`)
  miss <- event_values(raw$`Missed target`)
  outcome <- case_when(length(hit) > 0 & length(miss) > 0 ~ "Both recorded",
    length(hit) > 0 ~ "Hit", length(miss) > 0 ~ "Miss", TRUE ~ "No outcome recorded")
  ending <- c(hit, miss)
  end_frame <- if (length(ending) == 1 && is.finite(ending)) ending else NA_real_
  frame_ok <- nrow(d) >= 5 && all(is.finite(d$Frame)) &&
    all(d$Frame == round(d$Frame)) && all(diff(d$Frame) == 1)
  events_ok <- is.finite(pixel) && is.finite(end_frame) && end_frame > pixel &&
    pixel %in% d$Frame && end_frame %in% d$Frame
  d <- d |> mutate(
    Time_ms = Frame - pixel,
    Time_s = Frame / fs,
    Position_smoothed = center_mean(Right_HandX, smooth_n),
    Velocity_from_position = differentiate(Position_smoothed, Time_s),
    Acceleration_from_position = differentiate(Velocity_from_position, Time_s),
    Velocity_raw_position = differentiate(Right_HandX, Time_s),
    Acceleration_raw_position = differentiate(Velocity_raw_position, Time_s),
    Acceleration_from_velocity = differentiate(Right_HandVelX, Time_s),
    In_response = events_ok & Frame >= pixel & Frame <= end_frame
  )
  response <- d |> filter(In_response)
  signal_ok <- nrow(response) >= 3 && all(is.finite(response$Acceleration_from_position))
  reasons <- c(if (!frame_ok) "Invalid frame sequence",
    if (!events_ok) "Invalid or missing event window",
    if (events_ok && !signal_ok) "Incomplete derived response signal")
  numeric_parse_failures <- sum(vapply(signal_columns, function(nm) {
    text <- raw[[nm]]
    sum(!is.na(text) & nzchar(trimws(text)) & !is.finite(d[[nm]]))
  }, numeric(1)))
  audit <- tibble(
    Trial_ID = file, Import_OK = TRUE, Import_error = NA_character_,
    Rows = nrow(d), Pixel_entries = length(event_values(raw$`Pixel event`)),
    Hit_entries = length(hit), Miss_entries = length(miss), Outcome = outcome,
    Pixel_frame = pixel, End_frame = end_frame, End_ms = end_frame - pixel,
    Frame_OK = frame_ok, Events_OK = events_ok, Signal_OK = signal_ok,
    Duplicate_frames = sum(duplicated(d$Frame)),
    Frame_gaps = sum(diff(d$Frame) > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Nonincreasing_steps = sum(diff(d$Frame) <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    Numeric_parse_failures = numeric_parse_failures,
    Missing_position = sum(!is.finite(d$Right_HandX)),
    Missing_recorded_acceleration = sum(!is.finite(d$Right_HandAccX)),
    Baseline_samples = sum(d$Time_ms >= baseline_limits[1] & d$Time_ms <= baseline_limits[2] &
                            is.finite(d$Acceleration_from_position), na.rm = TRUE),
    Plot_start_available = any(d$Time_ms == plot_limits[1], na.rm = TRUE),
    Plot_end_available = any(d$Time_ms == plot_limits[2], na.rm = TRUE),
    Eligible = frame_ok && events_ok && signal_ok,
    Exclusion_reason = if (length(reasons)) paste(reasons, collapse = "; ") else "Retained"
  )
  keep_end <- max(500, end_frame - pixel + 300, na.rm = TRUE)
  list(audit = audit, data = d |> filter(Time_ms >= -300, Time_ms <= keep_end),
       events = raw |> select(Frame, all_of(event_columns)) |> head(10))
}
safe_read_trial <- function(file) {
  tryCatch(read_trial(file), error = function(e) list(
    audit = tibble(Trial_ID = file, Import_OK = FALSE, Import_error = conditionMessage(e),
      Eligible = FALSE, Exclusion_reason = "Import failed"),
    data = tibble(), events = tibble()))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: import-all-trials
imports <- map(trial_info$File, safe_read_trial)
trial_audit <- trial_info |> left_join(map_dfr(imports, "audit"), by = "Trial_ID")
all_data <- map2_dfr(imports, trial_info$Trial_ID, function(x, id) {
  if (!nrow(x$data)) return(tibble())
  mutate(x$data, Trial_ID = id)
})
if (!nrow(all_data)) stop("No trial signals were imported; inspect the CSV schemas.")
all_data <- all_data |>
  left_join(trial_audit |> select(Trial_ID, Participant, Condition, Block, Trial,
    Background, Target_Speed, Outcome, End_ms, Eligible), by = "Trial_ID")
sample_index <- which(map_lgl(imports, ~ nrow(.x$data) > 0))[1]
sample_id <- trial_info$Trial_ID[sample_index]
sample_trial <- all_data |> filter(Trial_ID == sample_id)
sample_metadata <- trial_audit |> filter(Trial_ID == sample_id)
sample_label <- paste(sample_metadata$Participant, paste("Condition", sample_metadata$Condition),
  paste("Block", sample_metadata$Block), paste("Trial", sample_metadata$Trial), sep = " | ")
sample_events <- imports[[sample_index]]$events
# Release the intermediate lists; all needed signals and audit fields are retained.
rm(imports)
response_data <- all_data |> filter(Eligible, In_response)
if (!nrow(response_data)) stop("No valid response windows; inspect trial_audit.")
save_table(trial_audit, "trial_quality_audit.csv")
```

### Quality, retention, and event timing

```{r}
#| label: quality-summary
show_table(trial_audit |> count(Import_OK, Eligible, Exclusion_reason))
show_table(trial_audit |> filter(!Import_OK) |> select(File, Import_error))
retention <- trial_audit |>
  group_by(Participant, Condition, Block, Background, Target_Speed) |>
  summarise(Available = n(), Retained = sum(Eligible), Excluded = sum(!Eligible),
    Retained_pct = 100 * Retained / Available)
show_table(retention)
show_table(trial_audit |> summarise(
  Duplicate_frames = sum(Duplicate_frames, na.rm = TRUE),
  Frame_gaps = sum(Frame_gaps, na.rm = TRUE),
  Numeric_parse_failures = sum(Numeric_parse_failures, na.rm = TRUE),
  Missing_position = sum(Missing_position, na.rm = TRUE),
  Missing_recorded_acceleration = sum(Missing_recorded_acceleration, na.rm = TRUE),
  Incomplete_baselines = sum(Baseline_samples < diff(baseline_limits) + 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  Missing_plot_start = sum(!Plot_start_available, na.rm = TRUE),
  Missing_plot_end = sum(!Plot_end_available, na.rm = TRUE)))
show_table(trial_audit |> filter(Events_OK) |>
  group_by(Participant, Condition) |>
  summarise(N = n(), Minimum_ms = min(End_ms), Median_ms = median(End_ms),
    Maximum_ms = max(End_ms), End_before_500 = sum(End_ms < 500)))
ggplot(filter(trial_audit, Events_OK), aes(Background, End_ms, fill = Target_Speed)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = .3) + facet_grid(Participant ~ Condition) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Pixel-to-ending-event duration (ms)",
    title = "The analysis window ends at each trial's hit or miss event") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
save_table(retention, "retained_trial_counts.csv")
```

## Original EDA: selected trial averages and variability

These reproduce the comparisons in original Sections 10–16 and 21–23 using
recorded signals, with repeated plot variants consolidated. The first selection
is Participant A, Condition A, Block 1, static background, slow target. The last
two plots pool all three blocks, as in the original script. These remain
**descriptive plots over a fixed window**, including post-outcome context.
Static trials remain useful for comparison even if they are ultimately mapped
to the excluded “none” onset group. Shading is SD across trials, not a confidence
interval or uncertainty across participants.

```{r}
#| label: original-averages
legacy_data <- all_data |> filter(Eligible, Participant == "Participant A",
  Condition == "A", Target_Speed == "SlowTarget", between(Time_ms, -200, 500))
legacy_one_block <- legacy_data |> filter(Block == 1, Background == "StaticBackground")
legacy_summary <- legacy_one_block |> group_by(Time_ms) |>
  summarise(Mean = finite_mean(Right_HandAccX), SD = finite_sd(Right_HandAccX),
    N = sum(is.finite(Right_HandAccX)))
legacy_n <- n_distinct(legacy_one_block$Trial_ID)
p_legacy <- ggplot(legacy_one_block, aes(Time_ms, Right_HandAccX, group = Trial_ID)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray60", alpha = .25, linewidth = .25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = legacy_summary, aes(x = Time_ms, ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#0072B2", alpha = .15) +
  geom_line(data = legacy_summary, aes(Time_ms, Mean), inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#0072B2", linewidth = .8) + event_lines() +
  labs(title = "Individual and mean recorded lateral acceleration",
    subtitle = paste("Participant A | Condition A | Block 1 | Static | Slow | n =", legacy_n),
    x = "Time after Pixel event (ms)", y = "Acceleration (m/s^2)",
    caption = "Gray: individual trials. Blue: mean. Band: +/-1 SD. Fixed plotting window.")
p_legacy
save_figure(p_legacy, "original_individual_mean_variability.png")
show_table(trial_info |> filter(Participant == "Participant A", Condition == "A",
  Block == 1, Target_Speed == "SlowTarget") |> count(Background))

legacy_background <- legacy_data |> filter(Block == 1) |> group_by(Background, Time_ms) |>
  summarise(Acceleration = finite_mean(Right_HandAccX), Velocity = finite_mean(Right_HandVelX))
legacy_background |> pivot_longer(c(Acceleration, Velocity), names_to = "Signal", values_to = "Mean") |>
  ggplot(aes(Time_ms, Mean, color = Background)) + geom_line(linewidth = .6) +

    subtitle = "Participant A | Condition A | Block 1 | Slow target",
    x = "Time after Pixel event (ms)", y = "Acceleration (m/s^2) or velocity (m/s)")

legacy_velocity <- legacy_data |> group_by(Background, Time_ms) |>
  summarise(Mean = finite_mean(Right_HandVelX))
p_velocity <- ggplot(legacy_velocity, aes(Time_ms, Mean, color = Background)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) + event_lines() + scale_color_manual(values = background_colors) +
  labs(title = "Average lateral velocity across all three blocks",
    subtitle = "Participant A | Condition A | Slow target",
    x = "Time after Pixel event (ms)", y = "Recorded velocity (m/s)")
p_velocity
save_figure(p_velocity, "original_all_blocks_velocity.png")

legacy_acceleration <- legacy_data |> filter(Background == "StaticBackground")
legacy_all_summary <- legacy_acceleration |> group_by(Time_ms) |>
```

## Original EDA: trial outcomes and hit rates

Original Sections 18–20 are retained here. “Both recorded,” missing outcomes,
and failed imports are shown explicitly. Hit rates use all available trials as
the denominator, matching the original script; the valid-outcome denominator
is also provided so incomplete event records remain visible.

```{r}
#| label: outcome-tables
trial_outcomes <- trial_audit |> mutate(Outcome = replace_na(Outcome, "Import failed"))
show_table(trial_outcomes |> count(Outcome) |> mutate(Percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)))
show_table(trial_outcomes |> count(Participant, Outcome))
hit_rate <- function(d, groups) {
  d |> group_by(across(all_of(groups))) |>
    summarise(Total_trials = n(), Hits = sum(Outcome == "Hit"), Misses = sum(Outcome == "Miss"),
      Other = sum(!Outcome %in% c("Hit", "Miss"))) |>
    mutate(Hit_rate_all = 100 * Hits / Total_trials,
      Hit_rate_valid_outcomes = if_else(Hits + Misses > 0, 100 * Hits / (Hits + Misses), NA_real_))
}
show_table(hit_rate(trial_outcomes, c("Participant", "Condition")))
show_table(hit_rate(trial_outcomes, "Target_Speed"))
show_table(hit_rate(trial_outcomes, c("Participant", "Target_Speed")))
outcome_by_cell <- hit_rate(trial_outcomes,
  c("Participant", "Condition", "Block", "Background", "Target_Speed"))
save_table(outcome_by_cell, "outcomes_by_experimental_cell.csv")
```

## Added EDA: validate position-derived acceleration

The original velocity-to-acceleration check is retained, alongside the required
position-to-velocity-to-acceleration calculation. Agreement is assessed using
correlation **and** signed bias and RMSE; correlation alone cannot detect a scale
or offset error. Different derivative conventions can also introduce a sample
offset. The supplied signals are comparison measurements, not assumed ground
truth. Numerical differentiation amplifies small position fluctuations.

```{r}
#| label: signal-validation
sample_plot_data |> select(Time_ms, Right_HandAccX, Acceleration_from_velocity,
  Acceleration_raw_position, Acceleration_from_position) |>
  pivot_longer(-Time_ms, names_to = "Source", values_to = "Acceleration") |>
  ggplot(aes(Time_ms, Acceleration, color = Source)) + geom_line(alpha = .7, linewidth = .4) +
  event_lines() + labs(title = "Recorded and differentiated acceleration", subtitle = sample_label,
    x = "Time after Pixel event (ms)", y = "Acceleration (m/s^2)")

agreement <- response_data |> group_by(Trial_ID) |>
  summarise(
    Correlation = safe_cor(Right_HandAccX, Acceleration_from_position),
    Bias = finite_mean(Acceleration_from_position - Right_HandAccX),
    RMSE = sqrt(finite_mean((Acceleration_from_position - Right_HandAccX)^2)),
    Velocity_RMSE = sqrt(finite_mean((Velocity_from_position - Right_HandVelX)^2)),
    Velocity_derivative_correlation = safe_cor(Right_HandAccX, Acceleration_from_velocity)) |>
  left_join(trial_info |> select(Trial_ID, Participant, Condition, Background, Target_Speed), by = "Trial_ID")
show_table(agreement |> group_by(Participant, Condition) |>
  summarise(Trials = n(), Median_correlation = median(Correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_bias = median(Bias, na.rm = TRUE), Median_RMSE = median(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)))
agreement |> pivot_longer(c(Correlation, Bias, RMSE), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(Background, Value, fill = Target_Speed)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = .2) +
  facet_grid(Metric ~ Participant + Condition, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Signal agreement across trials", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
save_table(agreement, "signal_agreement.csv")
```

## Added EDA: baseline noise, polarity, and threshold feasibility

The baseline is **-200 to -20 ms** relative to the Pixel event. It is a pre-event
reference during a reaching task, not necessarily a resting period. Its mean
and SD are descriptive; this report does not automatically subtract the mean
or replace the project's absolute thresholds with SD thresholds.

Positive and negative excursions are both reported before the direction
mapping is confirmed. The baseline fraction outside +/-threshold is a noise
diagnostic, **not** an onset detection rate. A large fraction suggests that a
small fixed threshold may be sensitive to signal fluctuations.

```{r}
#| label: baseline-features
baseline <- all_data |> filter(Eligible, between(Time_ms, baseline_limits[1], baseline_limits[2])) |>
  group_by(Trial_ID) |>
  summarise(Baseline_N = sum(is.finite(Acceleration_from_position)),
    Baseline_mean = finite_mean(Acceleration_from_position),
    Baseline_SD = finite_sd(Acceleration_from_position),
    Baseline_RMS = sqrt(finite_mean(Acceleration_from_position^2)),
    Fraction_outside_020 = finite_mean(abs(Acceleration_from_position) >= gmr_threshold),
    Fraction_outside_0125 = finite_mean(abs(Acceleration_from_position) >= alignment_threshold))
peak_features <- response_data |> group_by(Trial_ID) |>
  summarise(
    Positive_peak = finite_max(Acceleration_from_position),
    Negative_peak = finite_min(Acceleration_from_position),
    Absolute_peak = finite_max(abs(Acceleration_from_position)),
    Absolute_peak_ms = Time_ms[which.max(abs(Acceleration_from_position))],
    Response_RMS = sqrt(finite_mean(Acceleration_from_position^2)))
trial_features <- trial_audit |> left_join(baseline, by = "Trial_ID") |>
  left_join(peak_features, by = "Trial_ID") |>
  mutate(Baseline_complete = coalesce(Baseline_N == diff(baseline_limits) + 1, FALSE),
    Peak_near_boundary = Absolute_peak_ms <= 20 | End_ms - Absolute_peak_ms <= 20)
show_table(trial_features |> filter(Eligible) |> group_by(Participant, Condition, Background) |>
  summarise(Trials = n(), Complete_baselines = sum(Baseline_complete),
    Median_baseline_mean = median(Baseline_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_baseline_SD = median(Baseline_SD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_fraction_outside_020 = median(Fraction_outside_020, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_fraction_outside_0125 = median(Fraction_outside_0125, na.rm = TRUE)))
trial_features |> filter(Eligible) |>
  ggplot(aes(Background, Baseline_SD, fill = Target_Speed)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = .25) +
  facet_grid(Participant ~ Condition) + labs(title = "Pre-event acceleration variability",
    x = NULL, y = "Baseline SD (m/s^2)") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

sample_plot_data |> select(Time_ms, Acceleration_from_position) |>
  ggplot(aes(Time_ms, Acceleration_from_position)) + geom_line(linewidth = .35) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-gmr_threshold, gmr_threshold), color = "#D55E00", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-alignment_threshold, alignment_threshold), color = "#0072B2", linetype = "dotted") +
  event_lines() + geom_vline(xintercept = sample_metadata$End_ms, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(title = "Threshold magnitudes relative to the signal", subtitle = sample_label,
    x = "Time after Pixel event (ms)", y = "Position-derived acceleration (m/s^2)",
    caption = "Orange dashed: +/-0.20. Blue dotted: +/-0.125 m/s^2. Both signs are shown for diagnosis.")
save_table(trial_features, "trial_features.csv")
```

### Smoothing sensitivity on a balanced set of example trials

One reproducible trial from each participant × condition × background × speed
cell is selected by trial ID. Centered moving averages of **position** are
compared at 1, 11, and 21 ms before differentiation. A centered average does
not introduce a simple one-way delay, but it can spread post-event information
backward and alter onset. These panels illustrate sensitivity, not a validated
filter recommendation or a reason to force threshold detection.

```{r}
#| label: smoothing-sensitivity
#| fig-height: 11
example_ids <- trial_audit |> filter(Eligible) |>
  group_by(Participant, Condition, Background, Target_Speed) |> slice_min(Trial, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |> pull(Trial_ID)
sensitivity <- all_data |> filter(Trial_ID %in% example_ids) |> group_by(Trial_ID) |>
  group_modify(~ map_dfr(c(1L, 11L, 21L), function(width) {
    tibble(Time_ms = .x$Time_ms,
      Acceleration = differentiate(differentiate(center_mean(.x$Right_HandX, width), .x$Time_s), .x$Time_s),
      Width_ms = factor(width), In_response = .x$In_response)
  })) |> ungroup() |>
  left_join(trial_info |> select(Trial_ID, Participant, Condition, Background, Target_Speed), by = "Trial_ID")
ggplot(filter(sensitivity, In_response), aes(Time_ms, Acceleration, color = Width_ms)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .35) + facet_grid(Participant + Condition + Target_Speed ~ Background) +
  labs(title = "Differentiated position is sensitive to smoothing", color = "Position window (ms)",
    x = "Time after Pixel event (ms)", y = "Acceleration (m/s^2)")
```

## Added EDA: trial-level distributions, unusual trials, and outcomes

Peak features here use the **largest absolute signed-signal excursion** as a
direction-neutral screening measure. That is different from the relevant
positive response peak needed for onset after confirming the response signs.
A boundary peak flags a trial for inspection rather than automatically
excluding it. Retain participant-level distinctions: repeated trials from two
participants do not establish population-level precision.

```{r}

#| fig-height: 10
trial_features |> filter(Eligible) |>
  select(Participant, Condition, Background, Target_Speed, Absolute_peak, Absolute_peak_ms, End_ms) |>
  pivot_longer(c(Absolute_peak, Absolute_peak_ms, End_ms), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(Background, Value, fill = Target_Speed)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = .2) +
  facet_grid(Feature ~ Participant + Condition, scales = "free_y") +

    caption = "Absolute_peak: m/s^2. Absolute_peak_ms and End_ms: milliseconds after Pixel event.") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

show_table(trial_features |> filter(Eligible) |> group_by(Participant, Condition, Background) |>
  summarise(Trials = n(), Boundary_peaks = sum(Peak_near_boundary, na.rm = TRUE)))
inspection_ids <- trial_features |> filter(Eligible) |> group_by(Participant, Condition) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    typical <- .x |> arrange(abs(Absolute_peak - median(Absolute_peak, na.rm = TRUE))) |> slice_head(n = 1)
    extreme <- .x |> arrange(desc(Absolute_peak)) |> slice_head(n = 1)

all_data |> inner_join(inspection_ids, by = "Trial_ID") |> filter(between(Time_ms, -200, 500)) |>
  mutate(Inspection_label = str_wrap(paste(Participant, paste("Condition", Condition),
```

## Optional onset analysis: ordinary and threshold-aligned GMR

This section implements the procedures in the project README rather than
treating threshold crossing itself as onset. It is disabled until the proposed
mapping and coordinate signs are confirmed. Edit the table below if needed.
“None” trials stay in EDA but do not enter either onset method.

Participant × condition × direction × speed groups are kept separate before
any participant summary, with blocks pooled only at this stage. The participant
summary uses equal weights across available groups for ordinary GMR and equal
weights across valid trial onsets for threshold-aligned GMR; it reports coverage
so these two aggregation choices are explicit. Confirm the intended condition
and speed pooling for the final project analysis.

For each peak search, only the trial's event window is used. The **last upward
crossing before the relevant positive peak** is found, with linear interpolation
between adjacent samples. Because the README does not specify an additional
physiological peak-selection rule, the largest positive peak is the candidate;
its validity still needs visual review. Absolute values are not used to turn
negative noise into a positive response.

Ordinary GMR fits +/-20 ms around the mean-trace 0.20 m/s^2 crossing. Threshold-
aligned GMR uses each trial's 0.125 m/s^2 crossing, averages on a shared 1 ms
grid, and fits -20 to +20 ms about the shared alignment point. No interpolation
or regression window is allowed outside the valid event window. Incomplete
windows, absent crossings, nonpositive slopes, implausible extrapolations, or
incomplete trial contribution to the fit are flagged rather than forced.
This stricter complete-window rule is reported as a coverage limitation.

```{r}
#| label: onset-functions
direction_map <- tribble(
  ~Background, ~Direction, ~Response_sign,
  "LeftBackground", "Left", as.numeric(params$left_response_sign),
  "RightBackground", "Right", as.numeric(params$right_response_sign),
  "StaticBackground", "None", NA_real_
)
show_table(direction_map)
group_columns <- c("Participant", "Condition", "Direction", "Target_Speed")

last_crossing <- function(time, acceleration, threshold) {
  ok <- is.finite(time) & is.finite(acceleration)
  t <- time[ok]; a <- acceleration[ok]
  if (length(a) < 3 || max(a) <= threshold) {
    return(list(Status = "No positive peak above threshold", Crossing = NA_real_, Peak_ms = NA_real_))
  }
  peak <- which.max(a)
  if (peak <= 1) return(list(Status = "Peak at window start", Crossing = NA_real_, Peak_ms = t[peak]))
  candidates <- which(head(a, -1) < threshold & tail(a, -1) >= threshold &
                        seq_len(length(a) - 1) < peak & diff(t) <= 1.001)
  if (!length(candidates)) return(list(Status = "No valid upward crossing before peak",
                                      Crossing = NA_real_, Peak_ms = t[peak]))
  j <- tail(candidates, 1)
  crossing <- t[j] + (threshold - a[j]) * (t[j + 1] - t[j]) / (a[j + 1] - a[j])
  list(Status = "OK", Crossing = crossing, Peak_ms = t[peak])
}
fit_onset_line <- function(time, acceleration, center) {
  grid <- center + seq(-fit_half_width, fit_half_width, by = 1)
  if (length(time) < 3 || min(grid) < min(time) || max(grid) > max(time)) {
    return(list(Status = "Incomplete 41 ms regression window"))
  }
  y <- approx(time, acceleration, xout = grid, rule = 1)$y
  if (any(!is.finite(y))) return(list(Status = "Missing regression samples"))
  fit <- lm(y ~ grid)
  intercept <- unname(coef(fit)[1]); slope <- unname(coef(fit)[2])
  onset <- -intercept / slope
  if (!is.finite(slope) || slope <= 0 || !is.finite(onset) || onset > center) {
    return(list(Status = "Invalid rising-line extrapolation"))
  }
  list(Status = "OK", Slope = slope, Intercept = intercept, Onset = onset,
       R_squared = summary(fit)$r.squared)
}
run_gmr <- function(d) {
  curve <- d |> group_by(Time_ms) |> summarise(Mean = mean(Response), N = n_distinct(Trial_ID))
  crossing <- last_crossing(curve$Time_ms, curve$Mean, gmr_threshold)
  result <- tibble(Method = "Ordinary GMR", Status = crossing$Status,
    Trials = n_distinct(d$Trial_ID), Valid_trials = 0L, Crossing_ms = crossing$Crossing,
    Peak_ms = crossing$Peak_ms, Onset_ms = NA_real_, Slope = NA_real_,
    Intercept = NA_real_, R_squared = NA_real_)
  if (crossing$Status != "OK") return(list(result = result, curve = curve))
  fit <- fit_onset_line(curve$Time_ms, curve$Mean, crossing$Crossing)
  result$Status <- fit$Status
  required <- curve |> filter(abs(Time_ms - crossing$Crossing) <= fit_half_width + 1)
  if (fit$Status == "OK" && any(required$N != result$Trials)) {
    result$Status <- "Changing trial contribution in regression window"
  }
  if (result$Status == "OK" && fit$Onset < 0) result$Status <- "Estimated onset before Pixel event"
  if (result$Status == "OK") {
    result$Onset_ms <- fit$Onset; result$Slope <- fit$Slope; result$Intercept <- fit$Intercept
    result$R_squared <- fit$R_squared; result$Valid_trials <- result$Trials
  }
  list(result = result, curve = curve)
}
run_threshold_gmr <- function(d) {
  trials <- d |> group_by(Trial_ID) |> group_split()
  crossings <- map_dfr(trials, function(trial) {
    crossing <- last_crossing(trial$Time_ms, trial$Response, alignment_threshold)
    status <- crossing$Status
    if (status == "OK" && (crossing$Crossing - fit_half_width < min(trial$Time_ms) ||
        crossing$Crossing + fit_half_width > max(trial$Time_ms))) {
      status <- "Incomplete 41 ms alignment window"
    }
    tibble(Trial_ID = trial$Trial_ID[1], Crossing_ms = crossing$Crossing,
      Peak_ms = crossing$Peak_ms, Status = status)
  })
  crossings <- crossings |> mutate(Shared_delay_ms = NA_real_, Onset_ms = NA_real_)
  valid <- crossings |> filter(Status == "OK")
  result <- tibble(Method = "Threshold-aligned GMR", Status = "No valid alignment trials",
    Trials = length(trials), Valid_trials = 0L, Alignment_trials = nrow(valid), Crossing_ms = NA_real_,
    Peak_ms = NA_real_, Onset_ms = NA_real_, Slope = NA_real_, Intercept = NA_real_,
    R_squared = NA_real_, Shared_delay_ms = NA_real_)
  if (!nrow(valid)) return(list(result = result, curve = tibble(), trials = crossings))
  # Shift by the saved crossing, not by a rounded approximation to it.
  aligned <- map_dfr(trials, function(trial) {
    cross <- valid$Crossing_ms[match(trial$Trial_ID[1], valid$Trial_ID)]
    if (!length(cross) || !is.finite(cross)) return(tibble())
    grid <- seq(ceiling(min(trial$Time_ms) - cross), floor(max(trial$Time_ms) - cross), by = 1)
    tibble(Trial_ID = trial$Trial_ID[1], Time_ms = grid,
      Response = approx(trial$Time_ms - cross, trial$Response, xout = grid, rule = 1)$y)
  })
  curve <- aligned |> group_by(Time_ms) |>
    summarise(Mean = finite_mean(Response), N = sum(is.finite(Response)))
  fit <- fit_onset_line(curve$Time_ms, curve$Mean, 0)
  result$Status <- fit$Status
  if (fit$Status == "OK" && any(curve$N[abs(curve$Time_ms) <= fit_half_width] != nrow(valid))) {
    result$Status <- "Incomplete aligned regression contribution"
  }
  if (result$Status == "OK") {
    delay <- -fit$Onset
    crossings <- crossings |> mutate(Shared_delay_ms = delay,
      Onset_ms = if_else(Status == "OK", Crossing_ms - delay, NA_real_),
      Status = if_else(Status == "OK" & Onset_ms < 0, "Estimated onset before Pixel event", Status),
      Onset_ms = if_else(Status == "OK", Onset_ms, NA_real_))
    result$Onset_ms <- finite_mean(crossings$Onset_ms)
    result$Valid_trials <- sum(is.finite(crossings$Onset_ms))
    result$Crossing_ms <- finite_mean(crossings$Crossing_ms[is.finite(crossings$Onset_ms)])
    result$Slope <- fit$Slope; result$Intercept <- fit$Intercept
    result$R_squared <- fit$R_squared; result$Shared_delay_ms <- delay
    if (!result$Valid_trials) result$Status <- "No valid post-Pixel trial onsets"
  } else {
    crossings <- crossings |> mutate(Status = if_else(Status == "OK", result$Status, Status))
  }
  list(result = result, curve = curve, trials = crossings)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: onset-execution
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 10
if (!isTRUE(params$mapping_confirmed)) {
  cat("**Onset estimation was not run:** confirm the direction mapping and coordinate signs, then set `mapping_confirmed: true`. All EDA above runs independently.\n")
} else {
  onset_data <- response_data |> left_join(direction_map, by = "Background") |>
    filter(Direction != "None", is.finite(Response_sign)) |>
    mutate(Response = Acceleration_from_position * Response_sign)
  grouped <- onset_data |> group_by(across(all_of(group_columns))) |> group_nest()
  if (!nrow(grouped)) stop("No eligible directional onset groups.")
  grouped <- grouped |> mutate(Ordinary = map(data, run_gmr), Aligned = map(data, run_threshold_gmr))
  method_results <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(grouped)), function(i) {
    bind_cols(grouped[rep(i, 2), group_columns],
      bind_rows(grouped$Ordinary[[i]]$result, grouped$Aligned[[i]]$result))
  })
  trial_onsets <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(grouped)), function(i) {
    bind_cols(grouped[rep(i, nrow(grouped$Aligned[[i]]$trials)), group_columns], grouped$Aligned[[i]]$trials)
  })
  print(show_table(method_results))
  cat("\n\nTrial-level threshold-alignment status:\n\n")
  print(show_table(trial_onsets |> count(Participant, Condition, Direction, Target_Speed, Status)))
  diagnostic_curves <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(grouped)), function(i) {
    map2_dfr(c("Ordinary", "Aligned"), c("Ordinary GMR", "Threshold-aligned GMR"), function(slot, method) {
      curve <- grouped[[slot]][[i]]$curve
      if (!nrow(curve)) return(tibble())
      bind_cols(grouped[rep(i, nrow(curve)), group_columns], curve) |> mutate(Method = method)
    })
  })
  diagnostic_lines <- method_results |> filter(Status == "OK") |>
    mutate(Plot_crossing = if_else(Method == "Ordinary GMR", Crossing_ms, 0),
      Plot_onset = if_else(Method == "Ordinary GMR", Onset_ms, -Shared_delay_ms),
      Threshold = if_else(Method == "Ordinary GMR", gmr_threshold, alignment_threshold))
  for (method in c("Ordinary GMR", "Threshold-aligned GMR")) {
    curves <- diagnostic_curves |> filter(Method == method)
    lines <- diagnostic_lines |> filter(Method == method)
    if (!nrow(curves)) next
    p <- ggplot(curves, aes(Time_ms, Mean)) + geom_line(linewidth = .45) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = if (method == "Ordinary GMR") gmr_threshold else alignment_threshold,
        color = "#D55E00", linetype = "dotted") +
      geom_segment(data = lines, aes(x = Plot_onset, y = 0,
        xend = Plot_crossing + fit_half_width,
        yend = Intercept + Slope * (Plot_crossing + fit_half_width)),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "#0072B2") +
      geom_vline(data = lines, aes(xintercept = Plot_crossing), linetype = "dashed", color = "#D55E00") +
      geom_vline(data = lines, aes(xintercept = Plot_onset), linetype = "dashed", color = "#009E73") +
      facet_grid(Participant + Condition ~ Direction + Target_Speed) +
      labs(title = paste(method, "diagnostics"),
        x = if (method == "Ordinary GMR") "Time after Pixel event (ms)" else "Time after threshold alignment (ms)",
        y = "Direction-consistent acceleration (m/s^2)",
        caption = "Orange: threshold/crossing. Blue: fitted line. Green: estimated zero intercept. See status table for flagged groups.")
    print(p)
    save_figure(p, paste0(if (method == "Ordinary GMR") "gmr" else "threshold_aligned_gmr", "_diagnostics.png"), height = 10)
  }
  participant_summary <- method_results |> group_by(Participant, Method) |>
    summarise(Groups_available = n(), Groups_valid = sum(Status == "OK"),
      Trials_valid = sum(Valid_trials),
      Mean_onset_ms = if (first(Method) == "Ordinary GMR") finite_mean(Onset_ms) else {
        ok <- is.finite(Onset_ms) & Valid_trials > 0
        if (any(ok)) weighted.mean(Onset_ms[ok], Valid_trials[ok]) else NA_real_
      })
  cat("\n\nParticipant summaries (descriptive; inspect coverage and group differences):\n\n")
  print(show_table(participant_summary))
  save_table(method_results, "onset_group_results.csv")
  save_table(trial_onsets, "threshold_aligned_trial_onsets.csv")
  save_table(participant_summary, "participant_onset_summary.csv")
}
```

## What to review before reporting final onset results

1. Confirm left/right/none labels, acceleration signs, and the meaning of Conditions A/B.
2. Inspect event-duration distributions, signal agreement, baseline variability,
   and candidate peak shapes. Check whether a short response window actually
   contains the intended correction response.
3. Document any filtering decision and examine onset sensitivity rather than
   choosing smoothing to obtain a preferred answer.
4. Review block, condition, and speed differences before accepting a pooled
   participant summary. Report exclusions and valid-group coverage with onset.
5. Keep trial variability distinct from uncertainty across people. This dataset
   contains two participants; no population-level inferential claims are made here.

## Reproducibility

Render this file from the project folder using Quarto's **Render** button or
`quarto render 02_exploratory_analysis.qmd`. Required R packages are `tidyverse`,
`knitr`, and `rmarkdown`. The HTML includes expandable code. With
`export_results: true`, audit tables, feature tables, and selected figures are
saved in `eda_output/`; the original `figures/` outputs are preserved.

The method constants above come from the supplied `working_projectREADME.pdf`:
0.20 m/s^2 ordinary GMR, 0.125 m/s^2 threshold alignment, and a +/-20 ms linear-fit
window. The README remains the project specification; the optional mapping,
filtering, grouping, and complete-window rules are explicitly identified here
as analysis choices requiring review.
